∀ {before after : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store Minidregg.Compiler.WorldKindCell.instanceLayout} {old next : Minidregg.Kernel.WorldKindInstance.Instance}, Minidregg.Compiler.WorldKindCell.instanceAt before = Option.some old → Minidregg.Compiler.WorldKindCell.instanceAt after = Option.some next → ∀ (same : next.descriptor = old.descriptor), Minidregg.Kernel.WorldKindProjection.footprint before after = Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.WorldKindProjection.innerFootprint old.descriptor old.store (same ▸ next.store))

∀ (descriptor : Minidregg.Compiler.WorldKindDescriptor.Descriptor) (before after : Minidregg.Theory.Store.Store (Minidregg.Compiler.WorldKindDescriptor.layout descriptor)) (field : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.CellField), field ∈ (Minidregg.Kernel.WorldKindProjection.innerFootprint descriptor before after).touched ↔ ∃ address, before address ≠ after address ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.WorldKindProjection.fieldOf descriptor address = field
